memoryRule: a binary choice opens one actual card, contracts the refused card, and moves a non-local counter-branch; the refused possibility determines the next active condition
interactionRule: a left/right tap or control commits a binary wager; arrow keys arm without writing; Enter or Space commits; Delete lifts the latest refusal; R releases decision memory
representationRupture: syntax seal, material relief, and depth-separated mobile -> browser-native branching atlas of angular cards and negative cuts
encounterRupture: keyboard attention, pressure release, and approach/departure -> binary wager in which the unchosen side becomes the next condition
temporalRupture: clause debt, load redistribution, and reciprocal aversion -> refusal memory that changes the active branch and the non-local answer
mediumRupture: inline SVG paths, Canvas 2D, and p5.js WEBGL -> semantic HTML/CSS geometry with deterministic layout variables
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, interaction evidence, production readback, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
